data.name: Hannah
data.gender_notes: Hannah is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Ḥannah, from the root ḥ-n-n, 'to be gracious'. Its root is Hebrew ḥ-n-n. Hannah, mother of Samuel (1 Samuel 1). Hannah is a Hebrew name meaning “Grace; favour”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hannah expresses “Grace; favour”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Ḥannah, from the root ḥ-n-n, 'to be gracious'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hannah total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
